definition: The rules of how words are used in a language.
examples: English grammar can be hard.
She corrected my grammar.
I bought a Portuguese grammar book.

spanish.definition: Reglas de cómo se usan las palabras en un idioma.

definition: Harmful things in the air, water, or land.
examples: Air pollution is bad in big cities.
Pollution is killing the fish.
We need to reduce pollution.

spanish.definition: Cosas dañinas en el aire, el agua o la tierra.

definition: Money given back to you.
examples: Can I get a refund?
The store gave me a full refund.
I'm waiting for my tax refund.

spanish.definition: Dinero que te devuelven.

definition: A bad body reaction to food, dust, or other things.
examples: I have an allergy to peanuts.
Her allergies are worse in spring.
Do you have any food allergies?

spanish.definition: Mala reacción del cuerpo a comida, polvo u otras cosas.

definition: All the letters of a language in order.
examples: The English alphabet has 26 letters.
My son is learning the alphabet.
Z is the last letter of the alphabet.

spanish.definition: Todas las letras de un idioma en orden.

definition: A book used for studying a subject.
examples: Open your textbook to page 20.
College textbooks are very expensive.
I left my math textbook at home.

spanish.definition: Libro que se usa para estudiar una materia.

definition: A very tall African animal with a long neck.
examples: The giraffe ate leaves from the tree.
Giraffes are the tallest animals in the world.
We fed a giraffe at the zoo.

spanish.definition: Animal africano muy alto con cuello largo.

definition: An African animal like a horse with black and white stripes.
examples: Zebras have black and white stripes.
We saw zebras on our trip to Kenya.
A lion was following the zebra.

spanish.definition: Animal africano parecido a un caballo con rayas blancas y negras.

definition: An Australian animal that jumps and carries its baby in a pouch.
examples: We saw a kangaroo in Australia.
Kangaroos can jump very far.
A baby kangaroo was in its mother's pouch.

spanish.definition: Animal australiano que salta y lleva a su cría en una bolsa.

definition: A small furry animal often kept as a pet.
examples: My daughter has a pet hamster.
The hamster runs on its wheel all night.
We keep the hamster in a cage.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño y peludo que suele tenerse como mascota.

definition: A sweet tropical fruit with yellow flesh.
examples: I love fresh mango.
She made a mango smoothie.
This mango is very juicy.

spanish.definition: Fruta tropical dulce de pulpa amarilla.

definition: A place where a river falls from a high place.
examples: We hiked to a beautiful waterfall.
Niagara Falls is a famous waterfall.
You can swim under the waterfall.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde un río cae desde lo alto.

definition: The front window of a car.
examples: A rock cracked my windshield.
Clean the windshield before you drive.
There's a parking ticket on your windshield.

spanish.definition: Ventana delantera de un carro.

definition: A small bag used by women.
examples: She put her keys in her handbag.
I bought a leather handbag.
Someone stole her handbag on the train.

spanish.definition: Bolsa pequeña que usan las mujeres.

definition: A sour liquid used in cooking.
examples: Add oil and vinegar to the salad.
The whole kitchen smells like vinegar.
You can clean windows with vinegar.

spanish.definition: Líquido ácido que se usa en la cocina.

definition: Thick, stiff paper used for making boxes.
examples: We packed everything in cardboard boxes.
The kids made a house out of cardboard.
Recycle the cardboard, please.

spanish.definition: Papel grueso y rígido que se usa para hacer cajas.

definition: A paper that shows you finished school.
examples: She got her high school diploma.
His diploma is on the wall.
You need a diploma for this job.

spanish.definition: Papel que muestra que terminaste la escuela.

definition: A person who welcomes visitors at an office or a hotel.
examples: The receptionist gave us our room key.
She works as a receptionist at a dental office.
Please ask the receptionist for help.

spanish.definition: Persona que recibe a los visitantes en una oficina o un hotel.

definition: A person who works in a library.
examples: The librarian helped me find the book.
My aunt is a school librarian.
Ask the librarian for a card.

spanish.definition: Persona que trabaja en una biblioteca.

definition: A person in your class at school.
examples: She's my classmate in Spanish.
I ran into an old classmate today.
He gets along with all his classmates.

spanish.definition: Persona en tu clase de la escuela.

definition: Your family name.
examples: What's your surname?
Smith is a common surname.
Please write your surname first.

spanish.definition: Tu nombre de familia.

definition: The woman who is married to your father but isn't your mother.
examples: My stepmother is very kind.
Cinderella had a cruel stepmother.
He calls his stepmother by her first name.

spanish.definition: Mujer casada con tu padre que no es tu madre.

definition: The child of your son or daughter.
examples: She has one grandchild.
Their first grandchild was born in May.
My parents love their grandchildren.

spanish.definition: Hijo de tu hijo o de tu hija.

definition: A husband or a wife.
examples: You can bring your spouse to the party.
Please write your spouse's name here.
My spouse works at the hospital.

spanish.definition: Esposo o esposa.

definition: A small pool of water on the ground.
examples: The kids jumped in the puddles.
I stepped in a puddle.
There was a puddle of water under the car.

spanish.definition: Pequeña cantidad de agua en el suelo.

definition: Not wearing shoes or socks.
examples: The kids ran barefoot on the beach.
Don't walk barefoot in the kitchen.
She was barefoot in the grass.

spanish.definition: Sin zapatos ni medias.

definition: A notice that tries to sell a product.
examples: I saw an advertisement for the job.
The magazine is full of advertisements.
We put an advertisement in the newspaper.

spanish.definition: Aviso que trata de vender un producto.

definition: A store that sells medicine and other small things.
examples: I stopped at the drugstore for aspirin.
The drugstore is open until nine.
You can buy that shampoo at any drugstore.

spanish.definition: Tienda que vende medicinas y otras cosas pequeñas.

definition: A person who comes to live in a new country.
examples: My grandparents were immigrants from Italy.
The city has many immigrants.
He's an immigrant from Colombia.

spanish.definition: Persona que llega a vivir a un país nuevo.

definition: A substance in coffee and tea that gives you energy.
examples: I need some caffeine this morning.
Coffee has a lot of caffeine.
She stopped drinking caffeine at night.

spanish.definition: Sustancia del café y el té que te da energía.

definition: A dish of beaten eggs cooked in a pan.
examples: I made a cheese omelet for breakfast.
He ordered a ham omelet.
This omelet needs more salt.

spanish.definition: Plato de huevos batidos cocinados en una sartén.

definition: A round bread with a hole in the middle.
examples: I had a bagel with cream cheese.
New York is famous for its bagels.
She toasted a bagel for breakfast.

spanish.definition: Pan redondo con un hueco en el medio.

definition: A flat square piece used to cover floors or walls.
examples: The bathroom has white tile.
One of the roof tiles fell off.
We put new tile in the kitchen.

spanish.definition: Pieza plana y cuadrada usada para cubrir pisos o paredes.

definition: A machine that washes dishes.
examples: Put the plates in the dishwasher.
Our dishwasher is broken.
He works as a dishwasher at a restaurant.

spanish.definition: Máquina que lava los platos.

definition: A small room or closet for keeping food.
examples: The rice is in the pantry.
Our pantry is full of cans.
She keeps her flour in the pantry.

spanish.definition: Cuarto pequeño o clóset donde se guarda la comida.

definition: A glass tank for fish; a building where you can see fish.
examples: We took the kids to the aquarium.
He has a big aquarium in his living room.
The sharks at the aquarium are amazing.

spanish.definition: Tanque de vidrio para peces; edificio donde puedes ver peces.

definition: A game in which two teams hit a ball over a net.
examples: We played volleyball on the beach.
She's on the volleyball team.
Do you want to play volleyball?

spanish.definition: Juego en el que dos equipos pasan una pelota sobre una red.

definition: A general change; a popular style.
examples: This is the latest fashion trend.
There's a trend toward working from home.
Home prices show an upward trend.

spanish.definition: Cambio general; estilo popular.

definition: To change and correct writing, photos, or video.
examples: She edits a magazine.
I edited my paper before I turned it in.
He's editing the video on his laptop.

spanish.definition: Cambiar y corregir textos, fotos o videos.

definition: A red-brown layer on old iron.
examples: There's rust on my bike.
The car is covered in rust.
Salt water can cause rust.

spanish.definition: Capa rojiza sobre el hierro viejo.

definition: A group of sentences about one idea.
examples: Read the first paragraph.
Write a paragraph about your family.
The last paragraph is the best one.

spanish.definition: Grupo de oraciones sobre una idea.

definition: A liquid you put on your skin.
examples: Put some lotion on your dry hands.
Don't forget your suntan lotion.
This body lotion smells like coconut.

spanish.definition: Líquido que te pones en la piel.

definition: To take things out of a bag or a box.
examples: I haven't unpacked my suitcase yet.
We unpacked the dishes first.
She's unpacking the groceries.

spanish.definition: Sacar cosas de un bolso o una caja.

definition: Happening or used outside.
examples: The hotel has an outdoor pool.
We love outdoor activities.
There's an outdoor concert tonight.

spanish.definition: Que pasa o se usa afuera.

definition: An amount of something.
examples: We bought a large quantity of rice.
I prefer quality over quantity.
What quantity do you need?

spanish.definition: Monto de algo.

definition: Clear enough to see through; honest and open.
examples: The bag is made of transparent plastic.
The water is completely transparent.
The company should be more transparent.

spanish.definition: Lo bastante claro para ver a través; honesto y abierto.

definition: A person who buys things.
examples: Consumers want lower prices.
This law protects consumers.
The US is a big consumer of oil.

spanish.definition: Persona que compra cosas.

definition: The state of being healthy and strong.
examples: She has a fitness app on her phone.
He runs to keep up his fitness.
The fitness center is open at six.

spanish.definition: Estado de estar sano y fuerte.

definition: A statement about what will happen, like the weather.
examples: The forecast says it will rain.
Experts forecast a warm winter.
Did you see the weather forecast?

spanish.definition: Afirmación sobre lo que va a pasar, como el clima.

definition: Hard to please, especially about food.
examples: My son is a picky eater.
Don't be so picky.
She's very picky about her clothes.

spanish.definition: Difícil de complacer, sobre todo con la comida.

definition: To laugh in a quiet, silly way; this kind of laugh.
examples: The girls giggled in the back of the class.
The baby giggles when you tickle her.
I heard a little giggle.

spanish.definition: Reírse de forma suave y tonta; este tipo de risa.

definition: To smile widely; a wide smile.
examples: He grinned at me from across the room.
She had a big grin on her face.
Why are you grinning?

spanish.definition: Sonreír de forma amplia; sonrisa amplia.

definition: To form a round shape; a piece of hair with a round shape.
examples: The cat curled up on the sofa.
She has beautiful curls.
He curled his hand into a fist.

spanish.definition: Formar una figura redonda; mechón de pelo con esa forma.

definition: To almost fall while walking.
examples: I stumbled on the stairs.
He stumbled over a rock.
She's stumbling around in the dark.

spanish.definition: Casi caerse al caminar.

definition: To add a number to itself many times; to increase quickly.
examples: Multiply five by three.
Our problems have multiplied.
The kids are learning how to multiply.

spanish.definition: Sumar un número a sí mismo muchas veces; aumentar rápido.

definition: To make something valid for more time.
examples: I need to renew my passport.
She renewed her gym membership.
You can renew your books online.

spanish.definition: Hacer que algo sea válido por más tiempo.

definition: Causing damage.
examples: Smoking is harmful to your health.
This chemical is harmful to children.
Too much sun can be harmful.

spanish.definition: Que causa daño.

definition: Giving pleasure.
examples: We had an enjoyable evening.
It was a very enjoyable trip.
The book is short and enjoyable.

spanish.definition: Que da placer.

definition: Not right.
examples: Your answer is incorrect.
The password is incorrect.
This information is incorrect.

spanish.definition: Que no es correcto.

definition: To learn something so you remember it exactly.
examples: I memorized the poem.
Actors have to memorize their lines.
She's memorizing new words every day.

spanish.definition: Aprender algo para recordarlo exactamente.

definition: To make something look nice by adding things.
examples: We decorated the tree together.
She decorated the cake with fruit.
They're decorating the room for the party.

spanish.definition: Hacer que algo se vea bonito agregándole cosas.

definition: To teach someone.
examples: Parents should educate their kids about money.
She was educated in Boston.
We're educating people about healthy food.

spanish.definition: Enseñarle a alguien.

definition: To say what is wrong with someone or something.
examples: Don't criticize your sister.
The newspaper criticized the mayor.
He's always criticizing my cooking.

spanish.definition: Decir qué está mal en alguien o algo.

definition: The place where you work.
examples: Safety in the workplace is very important.
Smoking isn't allowed in the workplace.
She has a friendly workplace.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde trabajas.

definition: To become red in the face because you are shy.
examples: She blushed when he said hello.
You're blushing!
He blushes when people look at him.

spanish.definition: Ponerse rojo en la cara por timidez.

definition: To hold someone close with love.
examples: She cuddled her baby.
We cuddled on the sofa.
The kids are cuddling with the puppy.

spanish.definition: Sostener a alguien cerca con amor.

definition: An informal word for comfortable.
examples: This sofa is really comfy.
I'm wearing my comfy shoes.
Are you comfy in that chair?

spanish.definition: Palabra informal para cómodo.

definition: To make the loud noise of a car horn.
examples: The driver behind me honked.
Stop honking your horn!
People are honking in the street.

spanish.definition: Hacer el ruido fuerte de la bocina de un carro.

definition: Soft and light.
examples: We have a big fluffy cat.
She made fluffy pancakes.
There are fluffy white clouds in the sky.

spanish.definition: Suave y ligero.

definition: Too interested in other people's lives.
examples: My neighbor is so nosy.
Don't be nosy.
She asked a lot of nosy questions.

spanish.definition: Demasiado interesado en la vida de otros.

definition: Saying the opposite of what you mean to be funny or unkind.
examples: Are you being sarcastic?
He made a sarcastic comment.
She's sarcastic with everyone.

spanish.definition: Que dice lo contrario de lo que piensa para ser chistoso o cruel.

definition: To become hard to see clearly; something you can't see clearly.
examples: The rain blurred the view.
Tears blurred her eyes.
The whole day is a blur.

spanish.definition: Volverse difícil de ver con claridad; algo que no puedes ver con claridad.

definition: To shake because you are cold or afraid.
examples: Her hands trembled with fear.
He was trembling from the cold.
The ground trembled during the earthquake.

spanish.definition: Sacudirse por frío o miedo.

definition: A situation in which there is not enough of something.
examples: There's a shortage of nurses.
The drought caused a water shortage.
We have a shortage of chairs.

spanish.definition: Situación en la que no hay suficiente de algo.

definition: The smaller part of a group.
examples: Only a small minority voted no.
The law protects minorities.
A minority of students live on campus.

spanish.definition: Parte más pequeña de un grupo.

definition: Easy to carry.
examples: He has a portable speaker.
We took a portable grill to the beach.
This small TV is portable.

spanish.definition: Fácil de llevar.

definition: The state of being liked by many people.
examples: Soccer is growing in popularity in the US.
Her popularity went down after the scandal.
The show's popularity surprised everyone.

spanish.definition: Estado de gustarle a mucha gente.

definition: Showing respect.
examples: Be respectful to your teachers.
The crowd was quiet and respectful.
He's always polite and respectful.

spanish.definition: Que muestra respeto.

definition: Connected to the countryside.
examples: She grew up in a rural town.
Many rural areas have no fast internet.
He enjoys rural life.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con el campo.

definition: The way the parts of something are arranged.
examples: I like the layout of this apartment.
We changed the layout of the store.
The website has a clean layout.

spanish.definition: Manera en que están organizadas las partes de algo.

definition: Toward the back.
examples: She took a step backward.
He fell backward off the chair.
Can you say the alphabet backward?

spanish.definition: En dirección a la parte de atrás.

definition: The study of countries, land, and oceans.
examples: We have a geography test on Friday.
I'm bad at geography.
He teaches world geography.

spanish.definition: Estudio de los países, la tierra y los océanos.

definition: To explain the meaning of something; to change speech to another language.
examples: How do you interpret this poem?
She interpreted for the Spanish visitors.
He's interpreting the data.

spanish.definition: Explicar el significado de algo; pasar lo que se dice a otro idioma.

definition: Something a person or thing often does.
examples: He has a tendency to talk too much.
She has a tendency to be late.
There's a tendency for prices to rise in summer.

spanish.definition: Algo que una persona o cosa suele hacer.

definition: To make something better or newer.
examples: I need to upgrade my computer.
They upgraded us to first class.
This phone is a big upgrade.

spanish.definition: Hacer algo mejor o más nuevo.

definition: Movies made with moving drawings.
examples: She studies animation in college.
The animation in this movie is beautiful.
He works for an animation studio.

spanish.definition: Películas hechas con dibujos que se mueven.

definition: Very bright or very clear.
examples: I had a vivid dream last night.
She has a vivid imagination.
The painting has vivid colors.

spanish.definition: Muy brillante o muy claro.

definition: Not telling the truth.
examples: He's a dishonest salesman.
It was dishonest of you to lie.
Don't trust dishonest people.

spanish.definition: Que no dice la verdad.

definition: A large reptile with sharp teeth that lives in the southern US.
examples: We saw an alligator in Florida.
An alligator was resting by the lake.
Alligators have very strong tails.

spanish.definition: Reptil grande con dientes afilados que vive en el sur de Estados Unidos.

definition: An insect like a butterfly that flies at night.
examples: A moth flew around the lamp.
Moths ate holes in my sweater.
There's a big moth on the window.

spanish.definition: Insecto parecido a una mariposa que vuela de noche.

definition: An imaginary white horse with one horn.
examples: My daughter loves unicorns.
She has a unicorn on her backpack.
The story is about a magic unicorn.

spanish.definition: Caballo blanco imaginario con un cuerno.

definition: A person who works with machines or in a lab.
examples: A technician came to fix the internet.
She's a lab technician.
He works as a computer technician.

spanish.definition: Persona que trabaja con máquinas o en un laboratorio.

definition: The act of being present somewhere; the number of people present.
examples: The teacher took attendance.
Attendance is required at all meetings.
Attendance at the game was low.

spanish.definition: Acto de estar presente en un lugar; número de personas presentes.

definition: A tool for turning screws.
examples: Hand me the screwdriver, please.
I need a small screwdriver.
He opened the box with a screwdriver.

spanish.definition: Herramienta para girar tornillos.

definition: Late; not done or paid on time.
examples: This library book is overdue.
Our rent is overdue.
This talk is long overdue.

spanish.definition: Tarde; no hecho o pagado a tiempo.

definition: Able to be trusted.
examples: She's a trustworthy friend.
I need a trustworthy mechanic.
He's honest and trustworthy.

spanish.definition: Que se le puede tener confianza.

definition: To give someone a job or a task.
examples: The teacher assigned us a lot of homework.
She was assigned to a new team.
My boss is assigning the work today.

spanish.definition: Darle a alguien un trabajo o una tarea.

definition: To make something stronger.
examples: These exercises strengthen your back.
The trip strengthened our friendship.
They're strengthening the bridge.

spanish.definition: Hacer algo más fuerte.

definition: Not easy to understand or know.
examples: The instructions are unclear.
It's unclear who won.
His reasons are still unclear.

spanish.definition: Que no es fácil de entender o saber.

definition: Not fresh.
examples: This bread is stale.
The air in the room smelled stale.
Throw out those stale crackers.

spanish.definition: Que no está fresco.
